qualification: Verified payloads plus both CPU/GiB and PSS upper paired bootstrap ratio bounds <=1.02. This is a held-out local screen, not broad qualification of post-link output. All compilation, instrumentation and training complete before scored runs.
stage: conditional independent qualification after completed three-round triage
decision_rule: Do not promote if either primary resource upper paired bootstrap ratio bound exceeds 1.02 versus the input. Compare rTorrent independently; input improvement is not parity.
adaptation_before_measurement: This conditional ten-round plan was recorded during the follow-up triage, before any qualification measurements. Artifact identities and training remain fixed.
cpu_measurement: process user+system CPU clock, first payload through completion
pss_measurement: maximum sampled whole-process PSS from connection through transfer
triage_rule_per_candidate: paired median CPU and PSS ratios must both be <=1.02 to proceed; no promotion from triage
qualification_rule: independent ten-round experiment with new fixture seed; both 97.5% bootstrap upper ratio bounds <=1.02; functional multi-peer/multi-file checks required
condition: Run only if both paired CPU and PSS median ratios for link-order in the follow-up triage are <=1.02.
